##### Project general facts

The Haven 3 is an exclusive residential development by Meraki Developers that brings together contemporary architecture, elegant design, and a strong focus on quality living. Offering a limited collection of just 83 residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, the project is designed to provide spacious interiors, abundant natural light, and a tranquil atmosphere. Its clean architectural lines, cascading greenery, and refined aesthetic create a sophisticated environment where modern comfort blends seamlessly with nature.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated collection of amenities designed to promote wellness, relaxation, and community living. The development features separate swimming pools for adults and children, a fully equipped fitness center, landscaped gardens, outdoor seating areas, a wellness pavilion, children's play spaces, elegant social lounges, and a welcoming grand lobby. Every amenity has been carefully planned to create a balanced lifestyle that encourages both peaceful retreat and meaningful social interaction.

The residences are finished with modern, high-quality materials that reflect the project's commitment to lasting elegance and everyday comfort. Contemporary interiors feature premium finishes, thoughtfully designed layouts, and refined detailing throughout. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, combining functionality with sleek design, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to create interiors that reflect their own personal style.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Maijan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
